organization.name: Intuit Inc.
organization.notes: Intuit began operations1983, incorporated1984; Nasdaq IPO1993. Age describes company, not QBO launch. Kleiner Perkins backed Intuit in1990 according to its current portfolio story; historical investment, no current stake inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Simple Start
pricingTiers.notes: US regular monthly list price; introductory $3.80/month for three months excluded. Free plan is separate.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the official plan page; no plan inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Plus
pricingTiers.notes: Closest multi-user small-business plan; US regular monthly list price; introductory promotions excluded.

pricingTiers.name: Advanced
pricingTiers.notes: Highest QuickBooks Online tier mapped to enterprise role. Intuit Enterprise Suite is a separate product; US regular monthly list price.

moats.claim: Accountant collaboration and connected payments can create workflow switching costs as a business accumulates reconciled financial history.

productReasons.claim: Automated transaction categorization and bank matching reduce repetitive bookkeeping work.
Project profitability, budgets and inventory in Plus connect accounting to operating decisions.
Advanced adds custom reporting, batch workflows and Excel data sync for finance teams.
